summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Taal Tarang Garba mobile app. 14/14 backend pytest tests pass. All critical frontend flows validated via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844): Home contacts/CTA, Register validation + submit, My Pass OTP flow with pending badge, Admin login/approve. End-to-end approval reflection validated via backend verify-otp after approve returning approved=true.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow' shorthand instead. Does not affect functionality.

action_items: (Low priority) Replace deprecated textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius with the new 'textShadow' shorthand to silence console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection in all reads (good).
Date of registration auto-filled server-side (good, cannot be tampered by client).
Admin login is a static credential compare with no token verification on protected endpoints (admin list/approve/delete are open). Acceptable for demo but should be flagged as mock/insecure.
OTP is hardcoded 123456 and send-otp returns the hint in response — mock as expected and consistent with request.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a unique TEST_ prefixed student and deletes it in the admin_delete test. No persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_taal_tarang_api.py and run against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. UI testIDs are comprehensive: hero-badge, event-date-card, event-venue-card, contact-<num>, register-now-btn, field-*, submit-registration-btn, form-feedback, phone-input, send-otp-btn, otp-hint, otp-input, verify-otp-btn, pass-card, pending-note, pass-reset-btn, admin-login-card, admin-username, admin-password, admin-login-btn, admin-login-error, admin-logout-btn, filter-{all|pending|approved}, approve-{id}, delete-{id}, admin-toast.
rca_of_issue: No bugs identified. All 13 stated features in the review request behaved correctly.
